root_cause.text: The RSS LUT memory was allocated only during interface bring-up (ndo_open) via idpf_init_rss, so any ethtool operation that accesses or modifies the LUT before the interface is up, such as toggling rxhash, dereferences a NULL pointer because rss_data->rss_lut has not been allocated.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "The RSS LUT is not initialized until the interface comes up, causing the following NULL pointer crash when ethtool operations like rxhash on/off are performed before the interface is brought up for the first time." The patch moves RSS LUT initialization from idpf_vport_open to idpf_vport_alloc, ensuring the LUT is always available. The crash trace shows a NULL pointer dereference in memcpy_orig called from idpf_set_features, which attempted to copy from/to an uninitialized LUT.
